ValidationRule.description: Mandatory Fields when 'On Hold With Internal Or External Party' is External
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IDR_Task', ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Pend Case'), Subject = 'Case on Hold', ISPICKVAL(IDR_Internal_or_External_Party__c,'External'), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Pended_To__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Product_Manufacturer__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT( IDR_Pend_Reason__c )) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Following fields are mandatory if 'On Hold With Internal Or External Party' is External - External Party, Product Manufacturer, On Hold Reason
